findings.input: A serving or training observation published by servingattempt.Record or trainingworkflow.Observer.finish when (a) the recipe-state read fails and the incoming Verification is empty, or (b) the same recipe is activated again, verified, after the recorded attempt executed it not verified.
findings.expected: Publication carries the state the executed recipe and task had at execution. A failed state read is told apart from a historical absent state and earns no verified credit, and a later activation does not replace execution-time state. Legacy bytes, the own-verifying-run exception and partial or cancelled results keep their contract.
findings.actual: The two remaining owners still read state at publication and drop the lookup error: servingattempt.Record (servingattempt.go:117-119) and Observer.finish (session_observation.go:271-273). A failed read leaves an empty Verification; scorecard.unverifiedAside rejects only explicit not-verified/broken and accepts that empty value as legacy. A later same-recipe activation is written as the attempt's state in place of its execution-time not-verified state. Shown from source at 8acbf71d17dfd3e1e35313b370f900b21f0fdf10; no SQA execution.

findings.input: (3) Gemma accuracy over 32 independent media, each with two uniformly guessed 3-choice questions. (4) Two judges ranked on all-constant finite scores, and on probabilities (.9,.1) against (.45,.45). (6) Two GIF media inputs for their own bound renders, with one judge and scorer, decoded at 16 frames against 1. (7) The embedded SenseNova APG verdict edited to 0 wins, 524 losses, 0 ties, 80 media and tail 0.0001, Admitted left true, with Says changed consistently to 'admitted: a gain beyond chance, 0 wins, 524 losses and 0 ties over 80 media'; its evaluation IDs stay unchanged. (8) A render campaign resumed after an earlier item's request changed while its last item drew the same, or with truncated bookkeeping.
findings.expected: (3) The accuracy null matches the actual choice counts and within-media dependence. (4) Ranking uses the aggregation production scores with, and an undefined tau or omitted resamples are said, without a panic. (6) A reading is admitted only from evaluations bound to the same render, decode sampling and question contract, and a control offers a candidate only by the admission for its own model, recipe and request. (7) The record's verdict, counts and tail are derived through AdmitPreset and its bound evaluations, so drift is refused. (8) A completed arm or verdict is reused only for the same bound inputs, evaluator and producer; changed work is refused or redone, and truncated bookkeeping does not count as complete.
findings.actual: (3) Correct count minus sum(1/choices) against zero is taken as a fair sign for ExactPairedBinary: a medium is positive with probability 5/9, and uniform guessing passes the 22-positive threshold (nominal tail 0.0250512) with probability 0.0914273, above the 0.05 level. (4) Arithmetic probability means rank (.9,.1) above (.45,.45), the reverse of production softShare's geometric mean; constant scores give a NaN tau, all 2000 resamples are dropped and resampledTau indexes an empty slice. (6) judgedRender compares content, request, producer, runtime and scorer but not MediaInput.Decode or the question contract, readRender never calls verifyRendered, ResolveActiveExecution takes the current activation, and the embedded offering uses recorded no-loss flags (plus a recorded gain for guidance methods) under a published model name/preset key, without runtime recipe/request binding. (7) The native record test checks evaluation-ID syntax, displayed counts and admitted/refused wording, but does not recompute Admitted or Tail through AdmitPreset and the bound evaluations. Gained trusts Tail <= falseGain, so the consistently worded false gain in input 7 passes the record and gain checks and offers APG on SenseNova's page despite its stated 524 losses and zero wins. (8) Arm, suite and verdict skips trust names and file existence and accept truncated bookkeeping, and a new build is validated by re-rendering only the last item. Remaining counterexamples shown from source and arithmetic at 0c24aca5b670940f95c0f8156c13804a9e2fd9ea; no SQA execution.

findings.input: A retained ClipMotion observation of unchanged MP4 bytes, then a motion encoder checkpoint or FFmpeg/preprocessing configuration changes under the same encoder basename. The suite is compiled again with that old observation and the same matching clip-content digest.
findings.expected: Motion readings identify the encoder/checkpoint and decoder/sampling contract that produced them, so changed instruments cannot silently reuse or be credited with an old metric. Keep the repaired OCR re-keying, content checks and whole-set exclusion in the existing media compiler and observation producers; the observation instrument is separate from the answering judge.
findings.actual: The remaining motion instrument is not bound: writeMotion passes filepath.Base(encoderPath) to measureMotion; ClipMotion stores that Encoder string and clip/source content digests, with no encoder/checkpoint or FFmpeg/sampling identity. ClipMotion.validate requires only a nonempty encoder name, and bindObservations compares clip.Content alone before keeping the motion set. Changing an instrument while the clip bytes and encoder basename stay the same therefore leaves the old motion admissible and its actual producing instrument indistinguishable. Shown from source at ba0405e63d92653b84f617d8c332d5546529e444; no SQA execution.

findings.input: A worker attempt interrupted between RunWorker recording its start and keepRunning writing the marker, or between removing the marker and the deferred end write; and a record from before 6da610a60, whose marker and attempt took separate time.Now values.
findings.expected: The interrupted attempt is reported with bounded known effort or an explicit unknown duration, downtime never counted as worker wall, and start, exit, restart and landing accounting share one lifecycle identity.
findings.actual: The start stays without a marker, noteUncleanEnd cannot close it, and landing.cost charges the elapsed time to now through the downtime; an old record cannot be matched by Step and Started. Two active-start stores remain. Worker-Wall-Seconds drops the unknown interrupted wall and printCosts presents the rest as worker wall with no qualification. Read from source.

findings.input: A tool call whose parameter value is exactly <, << or </param, followed by its closing </parameter>.
findings.expected: The grammar admits the value and the parser returns it unchanged; a complete closing tag still ends the value.
findings.actual: parameterLessThan makes every < consume a following character that diverges from </parameter>, so a value ending in a proper prefix of the tag consumes the real closing tag as another less-than rule and fails at its final >. The fixture's comment promises << but its map holds only longer text. Read from source.

findings.input: On a case-insensitive Windows checkout, a task with Files [scripts] and Tests [scripts/held_test.go] whose worker calls edit_file or delete_file on scripts/HELD_test.go.
findings.expected: Both tools refuse the other spelling of the held file before mutating it, its bytes and presence kept.
findings.actual: The held-test wrapper compares cleaned path strings with slices.Contains, so scripts/HELD_test.go misses the held name, stays under the allowed scripts directory and is admitted; os.WriteFile or os.Remove then rewrites or deletes the held test. Read from source.

findings.input: Resume a completed ComfyUI prompt after changing the installation, or return two outputs of one node with the same basename in different subfolders. Compare the 2368x1344 own-size run or the 1024x576 six-section workflow. The standard and Turbo depth sections both start from the recorder's input PNG.
findings.expected: Keep the accepted producer and both outputs across recovery. State the memory instrument and sampling window, including missing samples on resume. Time both depth sections from the same input picture through estimation and decode. Separate setup and depth processing from denoiser pass timing using the existing step measurement.
findings.actual: The receipt binds only prompt and request, so retry can credit revision A's output to B. keep overwrites the same node/basename across subfolders. await samples whole-device use starting at retry. ownSizeReading compares process allocations to whole-card use and divides integration including setup by steps. At 140c7975e the workflow times standard depth after depthControlSection has already loaded the estimator, computed the map and PNG-encoded it. Turbo supplies the picture and runs estimation inside the timer. The retained 91.06 s warm total at 15ecde8d3 omits standard-depth preprocessing. ComfyUI's 10.142 s standard-depth recording lists no cache hit for estimator 612:438, while its 2.205 s Turbo recording lists estimator 366:41 and control 366:46 as cached. Dividing the full Turbo integration by eight also charges setup to denoiser passes. The omitted time is unmeasured.

findings.input: (1) A root package embedding value.txt, checked by go test . -run TestValue, with only value.txt changed. (2) A production file built with -tags=fixturelane embedding value.txt, checked by go test -tags=fixturelane ./p, with only value.txt changed.
findings.expected: The embedded asset enters the undo run's restoration set, so the unchanged test runs against the restored input and fails on its assertion.
findings.actual: (1) path.Dir(value.txt) is "." and the ancestor loop stops before adding it, so the asset is not restored and undoable says no production Go changed. (2) Production calls go list without the verifier's flags, so the tag-gated embed is not listed and the asset-only change skips the undo. Read from source.

findings.input: (1) On a fixed-seed MOSS cache miss, install a missing named adapter after Contents checks its path and before modelAdapter opens it. Remove it after the run and repeat. A required depth estimator has the same gap. (2) Between two same-size draws in a held MOSS Turbo render session, replace a LoRA at the same path with compatible weights that change a patched int8 projection. Keep the strength and tensor shapes. Compare the second draw with a cold draw using those replacement bytes and the same request.
findings.expected: Reject missing required weights before replay or loading. Keep the Windows read hold for present files and allow a supplied depth map without an estimator. Use the admitted adapter content identity for resident merge reuse. A changed adapter must produce the same merged bytes as a cold bind with its new weights. Identical bytes at the same strength should reuse the existing merge.
findings.actual: Source at 15ecde8d3. Contents records 'absent' without a hold, so a run can use weights installed later and replay under the absence key. For a replacement between draws, Contents names the new bytes, but bindMerged keys the GPU merge by paths and strengths. runRotarySampling binds before releasing the previous program. ResidentSession.bind finds the old pointer and skips convRotMerge. The retained ComfyUI captures verify six cold projection merges; the warm replacement is a source counterexample.

findings.input: Compare a recorded 1024x576 PNG with the same pixels plus one column. Give the mirrored-input check a short latent or a NaN while its baseline passes. For the BF16 and int8 comparisons, score two otherwise matching draws that each contain one +Inf against a finite, nonzero reference latent.
findings.expected: Check PNG dimensions and require nonempty, equal-length, finite latent vectors before computing dB. Keep +Inf for an exact match with nonzero signal. Use small in-memory cases for malformed inputs. Keep reseeded or mirrored draws in holdGoldenFloors, which checks their scores. Each precision comparison needs one recorded-input draw per case per mode and keeps its product or merge captures.
findings.actual: Source at 15ecde8d3. The 8x8 means drop the extra column. A short latent scores -Inf and a NaN propagates. All three negative-control checks accept either. One infinite element yields -Inf against a finite reference, so both precision checks pass -Inf >= -Inf. On valid inputs readGoldenCases also renders a changed input for every BF16 and int8 draw. Unused controls account for 12 of 24 draws in holdInt8Sections and 6 of 12 in holdMergedSections. The counts follow from source. Elapsed savings are unmeasured.

findings.input: Save a named prompt state on slot 0 with one supported model and max_concurrent=1. Make a rehearsal clone into a different directory. Serve the same model and recipe on that clone and POST /slots/0?action=restore with the saved filename and an idle slot.
findings.expected: Restore the saved state from the rehearsal's published object while preserving the source store, its alias, and its locations. Clone the immutable data without redundant full copies where the storage owner guarantees sharing is safe.
findings.actual: CloneStore links blobs/ but byte-copies objects/ and the database records with the original absolute locations. restoreSlot resolves the copied alias. objectstore.Open requires a published location equal to the clone's own object path, so it returns 'object store: object location is not published' and the route returns HTTP 500 despite the copied bytes. The clone fixture covers blob sharing and source survival; the slot fixture restores in its original directory. Source at 12f172302, no SQA execution.

findings.input: Complete a fixed-seed Wan prompt-to-video request with a writable store. Stop the server, install a different compatible umT5 checkpoint at the same path with the same byte count and modification time, then restart against the same store. Repeat the request with the same tokenizer, recipe and denoiser.
findings.expected: Verify that the current checkpoint matches the persisted identity before reusing the clip. The text-pipeline admission should reuse a proven unchanged checkpoint across restarts and compute again when its bytes change.
findings.actual: Source at 5e82b8710. TextPipelineIdentity loads the store memo. admitCheckpoint accepts its old digest on size and time alone. TestTextPipelineNamesItsCheckpointThroughTheStore explicitly expects the old name after a same-stat replacement even though a fresh digest differs. Reading passes that name to measuredRun, so the previous clip can replay before the new encoder runs. The replay consequence was traced from source.

findings.input: Use recipe run with an active LiveEdit model, a valid prompt and a stored source_artifact clip. In the otherwise valid clip-form JSON, give seed twice, first 7 then 8. An unknown field on the same form is also accepted.
findings.expected: Strictly decode each request once at resolveEditForm. Reject duplicate and unknown fields before clip resolution. Send both forms through the director's typed ExecuteInput path, preserving validation, authority checks and existing replay identities. TestClipFormRunRetainsItsRequest can check both forms and the refusals with its existing fixture.
findings.actual: Source at c79cfc121. resolveEditForm uses json.Unmarshal. A clip with duplicate seeds resolves and is recorded as an ordinary seed-8 request. A full request instead goes to next as raw text, so decodeJSONInput decodes its pixel and conditioning arrays again. The two-callback fixture requires that text handoff. Preserve the compact clip record and InputContent's digest for oversized full requests when removing it.

findings.input: After a passing needle-reference run, delete only fixtures/needle_upstream_calls.json and select lanes with -reached. The reader still names the old path. The same case applies to the models lane when only fixtures/moss/checkpoint.json is deleted.
findings.expected: CycleLanesReached selects the reader of the removed fixture, so the Needle or MOSS check reports the missing input. Use the existing reader lookup for deleted paths, or run the lane when its readers are unknown. Keep the current package selection for edits to existing fixtures.
findings.actual: Source trace at c71a1e230. The Git diff supplies the deleted path. TrackedDocuments lists only files still present, so documentReaders returns no entry. discover treats the missing entry as zero readers and omits the lane. Both checks fail on the missing file if selected. The retained gate verified selection for edits to both fixtures while they were present.

findings.input: In the existing mutantFixture, select a Go test that skips when Above(11) is false and otherwise passes. Above(v) returns v > 10. The baseline passes and reversing > to <= makes the only selected test skip.
findings.expected: Use the existing planverify verdict for Go tests. Count a failed test assertion as caught, a passing check as survived, and a skipped test or failed build as inconclusive. Exclude inconclusive attempts from the measured catch rate. The existing strong and weak fixture cases retain their verdicts.
findings.actual: Source trace at c79cfc121. planverify.Execute returns ErrVacuous for the skipped test. mutate counts every non-nil verifier error as Refused, so this example reports one of one caught without a failed assertion. A build failure before tests start earns the same credit. The undo checker already distinguishes ErrAssertion. The retained mutation totals do not identify why a mutation was counted as refused.

findings.input: Run the MOSS Ultra text-to-image request at 2368x1344 with its 50-step ER-SDE schedule and observations off. On the last executed step the next sigma is zero and the denoised prediction is already on the GPU.
findings.expected: Return the resident prediction directly on the terminal step. Confirm zero latent transfers for that handoff, identical final latent and pixels at the same seed, and correct release on success and cancellation. Keep ER-SDE's order and noise decisions in sampling. Measure the remaining nonterminal transfers separately before moving any solver arithmetic.
findings.actual: Source trace at 65255b6d1. runRotarySampling calls stepped even when the next sigma is zero. It downloads the current latent and prediction. ERSDE.Step then returns a host copy of the prediction and hold uploads it. The terminal handoff alone transfers 18.2 MiB (3 x 12,432 x 128 float32 values) for a result already on the device. Earlier executed steps also transfer both inputs and the result, plus noise on drawing steps. The byte count follows from the source. Elapsed savings are unmeasured.

findings.input: Serve one 50-step MOSS text-to-image request with guidance 1, no skipped steps or adapters, and a fixed prompt such as 'red fox under pine trees' repeated 64 times.
findings.expected: Run the existing text refiner once for this prompt branch and pass its resident output to each denoiser call. Keep reuse within the request and preserve branch-specific conditioning, rotary positions and adapter settings. Verify one refinement across 50 steps, identical seeded latents and pixels, and compare sampling time and peak device memory on the same request.
findings.actual: Source trace at 65255b6d1. compileRotaryDenoiserProgram includes textGraph.refine before concatenating text and image rows. Its inputs are fixed for this branch and do not include the latent or timestep. runRotarySampling executes that graph on every step, so this request evaluates the same refinement 50 times. The joint image/text blocks still depend on the changing latent. The count follows from the graph and loop. Elapsed savings are unmeasured.

findings.input: Use an active MOSS image recipe, prompt 'a fox', 8 steps, an undeclared preset and a syntactically valid file ID for a missing source picture. Compare the request with no dimensions to the same request with width 1024 and height 576. Also try the explicit dimensions with a stored PNG and enhance enabled.
findings.expected: Both size forms should return the catalog's unknown-preset error before reading the picture or opening the enhancer. Have MOSS admission propagate the preset error its existing resolver already found. Preserve the content identity of admitted requests and fresh execution when only a reusable file identity is unavailable.
findings.actual: Source at d0eaf0f9a. With no dimensions, Sized resolves the preset and rejects it. Explicit dimensions bypass that lookup. Beside later returns the catalog error, but Reading retries as FreshRun. preparedFirst then returns the missing-picture error, or reads a stored PNG and invokes the enhancer for a request with an invalid preset. The landing's retained check verifies the original negative-step case with both stored and absent pictures.

findings.input: In a models lane, start two selected tests in the same package in separate processes. End each process after the package and test start events but before either terminal event. Read the final lane summary.
findings.expected: The final summary should name both interrupted tests and the cause of each interruption. Use the named unfinished tests already in GoTestReport. Preserve the live output, the measurement record and the existing package verdict.
findings.actual: At 140c7975e the live log and measurement record now name the interrupted test. The returned error still loses its name. The parser puts the package before its tests in Unfinished, RequireComplete returns only its first entry, and laneVerdict joins those errors. Two interrupted tests in one package therefore have indistinguishable package names in the final summary. This is a source counterexample. The landing's retained check asserts the log and record and checks the returned error only for non-nil.

findings.input: Judge moss-fusion/neighbors with the prior unfused kernels at the same seed, dimensions and weights. They already produce the reference latents for text to image and depth control.
findings.expected: Keep bit-for-bit agreement and make the existing fusion check distinguish the unfused path. Use the warm pass measurement and the later fusion budget to establish elapsed savings beyond the observed timing variation. If only the combined change has a measurable saving, judge it at that existing speed check.
findings.actual: At 140c7975e moss-fusion/neighbors still selects only TestTheMOSSPassFusesWithoutChangingABit. It compares two final latent hashes captured before fusion. The retained copies landing at e849f2f97 already passes both on the neighbors baseline. Removing the neighbors optimization therefore preserves the required result. The plan's later fusion speed check runs in a different step.

findings.input: With the checkpoint repair and moss-fusion/neighbors complete, leave the card available, no row parked and no explicit dispatch override. Read the next step from the ordering committed at 140c7975e.
findings.expected: The rationale of moss-merge-time/do puts it and moss-depth-card/do before moss-fusion/budget and moss-fusion/do. Express that ordering in the existing plan so normal dispatch follows it.
findings.actual: Master moved the merge and depth steps ahead of the three per-pass rows. But the budget and do steps still sit inside the earlier moss-fusion item with no dependency on either setup step. ReadyFrontier and dispatchPriority preserve document order among eligible steps. Under these conditions the next selection is moss-fusion/budget, ahead of the merge and depth work whose combined target is about 19 seconds per warm workflow. Shown from the committed plan and dispatcher.

findings.input: Use the recorded 1024x576 MOSS Ultra image-to-image request with its valid source PNG, fixed seed, no depth control and denoise 1. The first sigma at sampler 506 is exactly 1. Compare with the Turbo image-to-image recording whose first sigma is about 0.90027.
findings.expected: After the existing source-image validation, start the full-noise case from its seeded noise without opening or running the source VAE encoder. Decide from the resolved first sigma. Preserve the request identity, invalid-picture errors, any separate depth control, and the source encoding for partial denoise. Compare seeded latents and pixels in both cases.
findings.actual: Source at 140c7975e. startLatent calls sourceLatent whenever an image is supplied. It scales the PNG, loads the encoder weights, creates a device session, compiles and runs the encoder, then closes it. Only afterward does startLatent multiply every finite encoded value by 1 minus the first sigma, exactly zero in the standard recording. One entire source encode contributes nothing to that section. The time attributable to it has not been measured.

findings.input: Use the recorded MOSS depth-control request at 1024x576 with its moss-control adapter and 50 guided steps (100 denoiser passes). The encoded control is fixed for the request. Its sigma window selects that buffer or zeros.
findings.expected: Have runRotarySampling keep the active control on the device for both guidance branches and use a device zero buffer when the window is off. Prepare each used value at most once per request and release it with the sampling inputs. Check attributable upload bytes, identical seeded latents at the window boundaries, and correct release on error.
findings.actual: Source at 140c7975e. Each branch passes controlAt's host slice to Retain. The CUDA executor copies it into a new host staging buffer and uploads it on every pass, including when the slice holds only zeros. The control has 64 x 36 x 256 float32 values, so 100 passes copy 225 MiB on the CPU and transfer 225 MiB to the GPU for at most two distinct inputs. These are source-derived byte counts. The time attributable to this input is unmeasured.

findings.input: Complete a fixed-seed MOSS text-to-image request with Enhance enabled, then repeat it through the same local capability without FreshRun. Use the same store, code, model files, active recipe, source prompt and exclusions. The mode-2 recording supplies a source and its positive and negative outputs.
findings.expected: Let the existing capability and run-recovery owners recover the admitted request's completed preparation or picture before opening the enhancer. An identical completed retry should open zero chats and return the same pixels. Bind reuse to the enhancer model, tokenizer, template, sampling settings and code as well as the picture inputs and current authority. Preserve explicit fresh execution.
findings.actual: Source at 140c7975e. preparedFirst calls EnhanceRequest before the session director seeks the stored answer. Every retry opens the 9B chat, generates a positive and a negative prompt (a third generation if the positive needs a retry), closes it, clears Enhance and passes the rewritten request to the director. An enhancer-open failure on the retry therefore prevents delivery of the completed picture even when all identities still match. The recording establishes the prompt pair. Retry cost and failure are source-derived, with no timed or failed retry observed.
